conventions.rig: Mixamo skeleton from Sitting_Talking.fbx (65 bones), skeleton only, 30 fps, frames start at 1
conventions.batters: rhb_ = right-handed (bat on RightHand), lhb_ = left-handed (bat on LeftHand, exact mirror across the pitch line)
conventions.coordinates: same as the batting clips: positions relative to the batter at the crease: toward_bowler / toward_off_side (the batter's own off side) / up
conventions.event_frame: 1-based frame of the ball event (beaten, edge, pad/body/helmet/glove hit, stumps broken); ball_hits_body_at_m = where the ball strikes the body at that frame
conventions.top_hand: in hit/dismissal clips the top hand leaves the handle on purpose (clutching ribs, helmet, shaking the glove, walking off); the bottom hand never leaves the bat
conventions.walking_off: dismissal clips end walking toward the pavilion (behind square on the leg side) - chain into walk_off_dejected_loop and turn the character toward your pavilion
conventions.chaining: non-dismissal reactions start from the batting stance and return to it

clips.note: forward defence, beaten outside off; holds the shape, looks back, looks at the pitch, resets
drives, misses, the stumps are hit behind him; looks round at them, top hand to the helmet, turns and starts the walk off (chain into walk_off_dejected_loop)
lofts it, watches it hang in the air, sees it caught in the deep: head drops, starts the walk off
shapes to pull, the ball is on him too quickly and hits the ribs; flinches, top hand clutches the side, doubles over, recovers
short ball jags into the top glove; the hand comes off the bat and shakes, walks away flexing it, comes back to the crease
late on the hook, struck on the helmet: head snaps back, staggers, crouches holding the helmet (pause for a concussion check), stands and resets
back and across, misses, struck on the back pad in front of the stumps; looks at the umpire, resets
forward press, bat a fraction late, ball strikes the front pad; jolt, then looks at the umpire (LBW shout moment), resets
goes deep in the crease to pull, the back foot treads on the stumps; looks down at them in disbelief, hand on the helmet, walks off
forward defence, inside edge deflects onto the front pad; small jolt, looks down for the ball
struck on the pad, looks at the umpire, the finger goes up: shakes his head and walks off

clips.ball_goes: behind square on the off side (keeper / slips)
clips.note: drives, gets a thick outside edge, whips the head round to follow it toward the slips (use with a catch or a dropped catch)
goes for the cover drive, ball beats the outside edge; freezes, turns to look at the keeper, shakes head, resets
just short of the crease after a run: hand on the helmet, looks back at the broken stumps and up at the screen, walks off
from the stance: drops the bat into the bottom hand, turns toward the pavilion, first steps (chain into walk_off_dejected_loop)
angry: swipes the bat through the air, hand to the helmet, then a brisk walk off (root motion ~3.4 m)

clips.heading: behind square on the leg side (turn him toward your pavilion)
clips.note: slow walk off, head down, bat hanging from the bottom hand
